parsed.explanation: The dossier documents state-tolerated, escalating targeting of transgender people specifically: an October 2025 presidential decree framing LGBT people as national-defense threats, vigilante mobs attacking trans women (August 2026), police raids on LGBT venues (2025), city raids detaining trans women into 'rehabilitation' centres, local bylaws used to fine trans women, and a documented death-in-custody case of a trans foreign visitor involving an extortion demand. This is tier-2 state-tolerated targeting plus documented societal violence with thin recourse, current and patterned rather than isolated. Mitigation is partial: no national trans-presentation offence, prosecution of the morality code selective, police sometimes refuse discriminatory local rules, and a paper duty to protect minorities with no shown enforcement. That sits above the near-certain-imprisonment tier (0.15) but below the unremedied-institutional-rule profiles (0.35), given the active mob violence, official threat-framing and a foreign trans death in custody.
